# Film frames

`film/` holds the real-scan film edges behind the Border panel's **Film frame** layer type:
one lossless WebP per straightened edge strip (grey texture + alpha) and `manifest.json`
(per-scan strips with band top/thickness, corner width, and the reviewed size/position tweak).

Generated by `scripts/pack_borders.py` from the reviewed extraction in the gitignored
`local borders/` workspace (`scripts/extract_borders.py`, `scripts/mark_borders.py`). Scans are
renumbered 1..N; the number → source map stays local. Re-run the pack script after re-reviewing;
it also updates `FILM_EDGE_SCANS` in `chromasmith-22.html`.

The source scans are the project owner's own material (own film scans, own Dehancer output,
own posts) plus Unsplash / rawpixel public-domain / pngegg scans the owner cleared for use.
